empty: When the room's audit has no entries.
refused: Badge on an audit line whose action was refused.
events.create: Each events.*: one line of a room's audit. <actor> wraps {{actor}}, the name of who did it; {{target}} (in the -target forms) is whom or what it was done to (a person, a socio's name, a channel). "Room" and "socio" are product nouns.
events.convert: {{actor}} turned their private chat into this room.
events.rename: {{actor}} gave the room a new name.
events.invite: {{actor}} invited someone; this form is used when the invited person's name isn't known.
events.accept: {{actor}} accepted an invitation and joined the room.
events.decline: {{actor}} turned down an invitation to the room.
events.expire: {{actor}} was invited but never answered, and the invitation expired.
events.remove: {{actor}} removed someone from the room; used when that person's name isn't known.
events.remove-target: {{target}} is the person removed from the room.
events.role: {{actor}} changed a member's room role (admin or member); used when that member's name isn't known.
events.role-target: {{target}} is the member whose room role changed.
events.archive: {{actor}} archived the room, making it read-only.
events.socio-request: Someone asked for a socio (AI agent) to join the room; the -target form names it.
events.socio-authorize: Someone let a socio into the room.
events.socio-withdraw: Someone took a socio out of the room.
events.lead: Someone made a socio the room's lead (the one that answers first).
events.lead-target: {{actor}} made the socio {{target}} the room's lead (the one that answers by default).
events.bind-source: Someone bound the room to a channel (a Telegram topic…).
events.bind-source-target: {{target}} is the channel the room was bound to (a Telegram topic…).
events.unbind-source: Someone unbound the room from a channel.
events.unbind-source-target: {{target}} is the channel the room was unbound from.
events.limits: Someone changed the room's usage limits.
events.denied: {{actor}} tried an action in the room and was refused; a Refused badge follows the line.
events.queue-cancel: Someone canceled a waiting message of another member.
events.queue-cancel-target: {{target}} is the member whose waiting message was canceled.
events.pin: Someone changed the facts pinned in the room for its socios.
events.other: An action this version doesn't know: {{action}} is its technical name.
